entities.summary: Keith Hollis Thompson II is an American professional basketball player for Al-Nasr Benghazi of the Libyan Division I Basketball League. He played college basketball for the Georgetown Hoyas. He also played for the Philadelphia 76ers and New Orleans Pelicans for a total of 265 games in the NBA.
